{"id":1911860835,"question_id":4214,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770518749,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1911860835/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Dominant Indices","memory":"32.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int dominantIndices(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-1 ; i++){\n            int cnt = n - i - 1;\n            long long sum = 0;\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<nums.size() ; j++){\n                 sum += nums[j];\n            }\n            if((long long)nums[i] * cnt > sum) count++;\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-dominant-indices","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1665}
